title: Discount billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = Discount (ebilling-r1 task 115; procedure-and-file-model.md 6.3). 13. A fee line's billed rate is at most the rack rate less the agreed discount, plus an optional tolerance. A check only ('rate above the agreed discounted rate', per line): Flag, never an adjustment. Rack rates are reference data (rate cards), never copied here. Parameters only: no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.

discountPercent.description: The agreed discount off the rack rate, in percent. More than 0, less than 100.

tolerancePercent.description: Percent over the discounted rate still accepted, 0-100. Absent = 0.
